item.title: Ithaca Indoor Track Sends Strong Squad to States

item.description: Maddie White wins the state and federation titles in the 1,500-meter race walk with a personal-best performance for Newfield track.

item.title: TGHA 14U Hockey Qualifies for USA Hockey Nationals
item.description: TGHA 14U hockey qualified for the 2026 USA Hockey National Championships after reaching the New York State championship game.

item.title: TC3 Men’s Basketball Continues Success in Macklin’s First Year
item.description: TC3 men’s basketball finished 13-10 and reached the NJCAA Region 3 tournament as Tariq Macklin led the Panthers in his first season as head coach.

item.description: Lansing baseball enters a new era under head coach Aidan Cobb as the Bobcats look to build on last year’s Section IV Class B finals run.
